dataset: fastMRI knee multicoil validation, CORPD_FBK only

split.selection: restricted to the 49 ky=368 subjects so data matches CUPID's hardcoded x_m_full buffer of (1,300,320,368) in src/train.py; no k-space cropping needed

undersampling.note: ky varies by volume (320-644), so the mask is generated per volume

coil_sensitivity.estimator: ACS low-resolution: Hann-windowed 24-line ACS block, inverse FFT per coil, divided by the root-sum-of-squares across coils; zeroed where RSS < 2% of max
coil_sensitivity.repo_note: CUPID computes no coil maps anywhere; load_data requires them in the input .npy

validation.against: reconstruction_rss in the source fastMRI file

coil_sensitivity.alternative_not_used: ESPIRiT (sigpy) - not installable while the sandbox has no network egress

network_input.type: CG-SENSE reconstruction of the R=4 data
network_input.role: stands in for the routine clinical DICOM image CUPID trains on

fastmri_plus.policy: test subjects drawn from box-bearing subjects first (seed 0)
fastmri_plus.note: Selection tested only for presence in knee.csv, which includes study-level rows with empty x/y/width/height. file1001715.h5 carries a single study-level row (slice 0, study_level=Yes, label 'artifact') and no bounding box, so 19 test subjects appear in knee.csv but only 18 contribute scorable regions.

revisit: none open: repo defines no slice convention, matrix size now matches train.py

annotation_coordinates.convention: fastMRI+ y is measured from the BOTTOM of the 320x320 reconstruction
annotation_coordinates.verified_by: registration check against the joint line; see v2/results/registration_check.json
